basic_info.description: Panoramic, unobstructed views captivate from the main living areas of this beautifully updated 1937 single-family home. Spanning 1,555 SF (per graphic artist), this 3BD/2BA home features thoughtful updates including a new roof and skylights (2022), updated electrical, and renovated kitchen and bathrooms. The main level welcomes you with generous skylights, stunning views through large windows in the living room, and seamless flow to the dining area connecting to both the kitchen and outdoor deck. The modern kitchen boasts newer stainless steel appliances, clever storage solutions including a retractable island, while two light-filled bedrooms and an updated bathroom with an oversized tub complete this floor. Downstairs, find a private primary suite with updated bathroom, convenient laundry area, and direct access to both the spacious 1-car garage (with additional driveway parking) and tiered backyard ideal for gardening or entertaining. Located in a charming Merced Heights with easy access to parks, libraries, Stonestown Galleria, and shops along Ocean Ave. Easy commute: ~1 mi from Balboa Park and Daly City BART stations, walking distance to MUNI bus and light-rail lines, easy freeway access.
